notes:
Ford Ranger (2019 PX3, US-market manual) units on the HS-CAN networks.

The module addresses come from the manual's Module Configuration and Parameter Chart and the networks from its Module Network Chart. The manual gives each module an address and says nothing of diagnostic protocol, session, identifier width or the pins of the diagnostic socket. The gateway module holds the socket and joins two networks to it (HS-CAN1 as DIAG 1 and HS-CAN2 as DIAG 2); the manual does not say which of them is on pins 6 and 14, so which rows a stock ELM327 reaches is unconfirmed. Five units of the chart sit on MS-CAN and are not here (front controls interface module 7A7, radio transceiver module 751, side obstacle detection modules 7C4 and 7C6, trailer module 791); MS-CAN needs an STN adapter (docs/vehicles/ford-gm-stellantis.md). Address 726 is named the body control module on this vehicle, and the smart junction box or generic electronic module on other Fords.

opendbc reads Ford ECUs with UDS service 0x22 and tester present 0x3E, so the profile names UDS and the default session. Treat every row as unconfirmed on a given car until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering.
name: ford-ranger
description: Ford Ranger PX3 (HS-CAN units), UDS over ISO-TP

Network (HS-CAN1) from '418-00 Module Communications Network': https://servicemanuals-backend.fly.storage.tigris.dev/manuals/Ford/Ranger/2019/PX3/418-00%20Electrical%20Distribution%20-%20Description%20and%20Operation%20-%20Communications%20Network%20-%20System%20Operation.pdf (snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261115133232/https://servicemanuals-backend.fly.storage.tigris.dev/manuals/Ford/Ranger/2019/PX3/418-00%20Electrical%20Distribution%20-%20Description%20and%20Operation%20-%20Communications%20Network%20-%20System%20Operation.pdf). The response identifier is the request plus 8, the ISO 15765-4 pairing, which https://github.com/commaai/opendbc/blob/master/opendbc/car/fw_query_definitions.py (snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261115133802/https://github.com/commaai/opendbc/blob/master/opendbc/car/fw_query_definitions.py) uses as its default offset for Ford; the manuals give only the request address. Unconfirmed on any car.
